budget.name: Budget Sightseeing
budget.description: Self-guided walking tours, public heritage monuments, municipal botanical parks, lake promenades, and viewpoint sunsets.
budget.included_style: Standard entry tickets, museum passes, and self-guided exploration.

standard.name: Standard Guided & Curated
standard.description: Certified local storyteller guides, priority monument access, heritage boat cruises, plantation tastings, and nature reserve entry.
standard.included_style: Guided walking tours, boat safaris, entry passes, and curated cultural shows.

premium.name: Premium & VIP Adventure
premium.description: Private 4x4 off-road jeep excursions, white-water rafting VIP gear, private sunset catamaran sails, private palace salon access, or bespoke tea tastings.
premium.included_style: Private specialized adventure guides, exclusive permits, private charters, and adventure sports.

ooty.name: Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train Heritage Experience
ooty.description: UNESCO World Heritage cog-wheel railway journey through dramatic tunnels and misty ravines.

ooty.name: Government Botanical Gardens & Rose Garden Stroll
ooty.description: Expansive 55-acre terraced garden featuring over 650 rare botanical species and fossil tree trunk.

ooty.name: Doddabetta Peak & Tea Factory Experience
ooty.description: Highest point in Nilgiris offering telescope house views, followed by live CTC tea manufacturing and tasting.

ooty.name: Private Nilgiri Forest Jeep Safari & Avalanche Lake
ooty.description: Exclusive deep-forest safari through restricted sanctuary reserves, pristine trout waters, and shola forests.

coorg.name: Abbey Falls & Coffee Estate Walking Tour
coorg.description: Walk among cardamom and pepper vines leading to a scenic hanging bridge fronting the roaring cascades.

coorg.name: Dubare Elephant Camp River Crossing & Interaction
coorg.description: Cross the Kaveri river by boat to observe elephant bathing, grooming, and learn about wildlife conservation.

coorg.name: Mandalpatti 4x4 Off-Road Jeep Expedition
coorg.description: Thrilling 4x4 off-road climb through rugged mist-covered grasslands to the cloud-touching Mandalpatti ridge.

mysuru.name: Mysuru Royal Palace Grand Tour & Illumination
mysuru.description: Explore the Golden Throne chamber, Durbar Hall, Kalyana Mantapa, and witness 100,000 bulbs illuminating the palace facade.

mysuru.name: Devaraja Heritage Bazaar & Chamundi Hill Walk
mysuru.description: Vibrant aromatic market stalls of flowers and incense, followed by panoramic city views from Chamundi Hill.

mysuru.name: Royal Heritage Chariot & Private Palace Curator Walk
mysuru.description: Private curator-led access through private royal archives and vintage carriage collections.

pondicherry.name: French White Town Heritage Architectural Cycle Tour
pondicherry.description: Pedal down bougainvillea-lined French colonial streets, yellow mustard facades, and Alliance Francaise.

pondicherry.name: Auroville Matrimandir Conscious Walk & Garden Meditation
pondicherry.description: Visit the golden spherical geodesic dome, learn about sustainable experimental town planning, and silent concentration.

pondicherry.name: Paradise Beach Private Catamaran & Scuba Discovery
pondicherry.description: Private motorboat into the Chunnambar backwaters and open sea catamaran adventure with certified marine dive masters.

munnar.name: Eravikulam National Park Nilgiri Tahr Sanctuary
munnar.description: High altitude grasslands home to the endangered mountain goat, overlooking Anamudi peak.

munnar.name: Mattupetty Dam Boating & Echo Point
munnar.description: Picturesque masonry gravity dam surrounded by rolling tea plantations and acoustic echo valleys.

munnar.name: Kolukkumalai Sunrise 4x4 Jeep Expedition
munnar.description: Pre-dawn rugged 4x4 jeep ascent to the world's highest tea estate (7,900 ft) for a breathtaking sea of clouds sunrise.

jaipur.name: Amber Fort Guided History & Sheesh Mahal Walk
jaipur.description: Regal hilltop fortress featuring mirror-inlaid palaces, Maota lake views, and Rajput architecture.

jaipur.name: Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar & Old City Walled Walk
jaipur.description: Iconic honeycomb facade of winds and ancient UNESCO astronomical observatory stone instruments.

jaipur.name: Hot Air Balloon Flight & Royal Nahargarh Sunset
jaipur.description: Sunrise aerial hot-air balloon drift over rugged Aravalli ridges and royal palace ramparts.

goa.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Guided Heritage Walk
goa.description: Walk among Portuguese heritage villas, colorful tiled verandas, art galleries, and historic bakeries.

goa.name: Mandovi River Sunset Cruise & Goan Folk Dance
goa.description: Evening catamaran cruise along the Mandovi river with live Dekhnni & Fugdi cultural performances.

goa.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Jungle Jeep Safari & Spice Plantation
goa.description: Open 4x4 off-road safari through Mollem National Park rivers, natural pool swims at Dudhsagar, and buffet lunch.

rishikesh.name: Triveni Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti & Sacred Ceremony
rishikesh.description: Atmospheric evening prayer with rhythmic Vedic chants, brass lamps, and floating leaf diyas on the Ganges.

rishikesh.name: White Water River Rafting (16 km Shivpuri to Rishikesh)
rishikesh.description: Thrilling Grade III & IV rapids (Roller Coaster, Golf Course) with certified river rescue kayakers and cliff jump.

rishikesh.name: Himalayan Sunrise Trek to Kunjapuri Temple & Downhill Cycle
rishikesh.description: Early morning drive to 1,650m ridge temple for 360-degree snow-capped Himalayan panoramas, followed by downhill mountain biking.
